# Spire Hub

> Spire Hub is Bahrain's home for ambitious startups — a coworking and startup hub offering coworking space, private offices, meeting and workshop rooms, mentorship, membership plans, and founder events. Located in Manama, Bahrain.

Spire Hub provides:
- Coworking space and hot desks for founders and startup teams
- Private offices for growing teams
- Bookable meeting rooms and workshop rooms, billed hourly (VAT included)
- Membership plans for individuals and teams
- Mentorship from experienced founders and industry leaders
- Workshops, founder talks, and networking events

## Key pages

- [Spire Hub homepage](https://spire.bh/): overview of coworking space, private offices, meeting rooms, membership plans, mentors, and events
- [Meeting Rooms](https://spire.bh/#rooms): bookable meeting and workshop rooms with hourly pricing
- [Membership](https://spire.bh/#membership): coworking and private office membership plans
- [Events](https://spire.bh/#events): upcoming workshops, founder talks, and networking events
- [Mentors](https://spire.bh/#mentors): founders and industry leaders offering mentorship
